units.source_text: 只有十名警察长期驻在那家温泉旅馆里，每天都拉大弓。

en.t: Only ten policemen were stationed for a long time at that hot spring inn, and every day they drew their great bows.

units.source_text: 当他们腻味的时候，村子里已是一片寂静了。

en.t: By the time they had grown tired of it, the village had already fallen completely silent.
